nodes.label: Web UI
nodes.summary: React single-page app where the user picks a project, chats with Claude Code, approves tool calls and navigates the project maps.

nodes.label: App Shell
nodes.summary: Sidebar with project picker, add-project form and chat list, routing the main pane between map, chat and settings.

nodes.label: Chat View
nodes.summary: One chat: replays and streams the feed, renders approval cards and the composer, and shows a map pane lit by the agent's reads and edits.

nodes.label: Map Screen
nodes.summary: Loads a project's diagram views, polls while generating, shows stale nodes and hands nodes off to a new chat.

nodes.label: Map Canvas
nodes.summary: Draws map nodes and edges with React Flow and ELK layout, with drill-down breadcrumbs and heat highlighting.

nodes.label: File Viewer
nodes.summary: Read-only viewer for the files and directories behind a map node.

nodes.label: Project Settings
nodes.summary: Edits a project's per-mode models and its allow/ask/deny approval rules.

nodes.label: API Client
nodes.summary: Thin typed fetch wrapper for the Flightdeck REST API, parsing responses with the shared contracts.

nodes.label: Flightdeck Server
nodes.summary: Node/Hono server that serves the UI and API, streams chat feeds over SSE, runs claude processes and answers their PreToolUse hooks.

nodes.label: HTTP API & Listeners
nodes.summary: Hono routes for projects, chats, rules, maps, files, approvals and the SSE feed, plus the loopback listener and the secret-checked gateway listener.

nodes.label: Approval Hook
nodes.summary: Decides each tool call Claude Code asks about: Discuss-mode refusal, per-project edit lock, project rules, else a held approval card with timeout.

nodes.label: Chat Runner
nodes.summary: Runs one chat turn as a headless `claude -p` process with hook settings, enforces the subscription tripwire and records the run.

nodes.label: Map Generator
nodes.summary: Spawns a read-only claude agent with a JSON schema to produce a map, validates it, writes it to .flightdeck/ and computes stale nodes from git diffs.

nodes.label: Rules Engine
nodes.summary: Matches tool calls against Claude-Code-style allow/ask/deny patterns with Deny > Ask > Allow precedence and suggests patterns for cards.

nodes.label: Chat Feed
nodes.summary: Appends feed items to a chat's JSONL file and fans them out to live SSE subscribers; replays the file on connect.

nodes.label: File Service
nodes.summary: Reads a project file or lists a directory for the viewer, confined to the project and never exposing .git.

nodes.label: DB Access
nodes.summary: Drizzle schema and boot-time DDL/upgrades for the SQLite database, closing out runs and approvals left open by a restart.

nodes.label: Config
nodes.summary: Environment-driven settings: port, data dir, claude binary, default model, approval timeout, gateway host and secret.

nodes.label: Shared Contracts
nodes.summary: Zod schemas and types shared by server and UI for API bodies, feed items, Claude stream events and maps.

nodes.label: SQLite Database
nodes.summary: flightdeck.db (WAL) holding projects, rules, chats, runs and the approvals audit trail.

nodes.label: Chat Feed Files
nodes.summary: Per-chat append-only JSONL files under the data dir that hold each chat's full feed for replay.

nodes.label: Map Files
nodes.summary: Generated maps stored as .flightdeck/<view>.json inside each project repo, with the commit they were made from.

nodes.label: Claude Code CLI
nodes.summary: The unmodified `claude` CLI on the subscription, spawned headless for chat turns and map generation and calling back via HTTP hooks.

nodes.label: Git / Project Repos
nodes.summary: The project git repositories on the box, queried for HEAD, tracked files and diffs since a map's commit.

nodes.label: SSO Gateway
nodes.summary: Shared nginx SSO gateway that reaches the server over docker0 and must send the X-Flightdeck-Gateway secret header.
